title: Test Papyrus automations slice 2 on Distinctive (PPY-9ff95b)
description: Distinctive is the test site for the Papyrus automation epic PPY-9ff95b. Slice 1 (5.32.0) is deployed and tested: record distinctive.ttab exists, router link matches, maxConcurrent kept at 1 on purpose. Slice 2 is Papyrus 5.33.0 (enabled real, limits enforced, cost recorded, run now, Notification Center, review requests).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Blocked (2026-10-23): Papyrus 5.33.0 exceeds the CloudFormation 500-resource limit in the CMS API FunctionDirectiveStack (Shipped's deploy failed at assembly). Distinctive's bump (#14) was merged but its Amplify job 50 was cancelled before changing anything; #15 reverted main to the deployed 5.32.0. Waiting on the Papyrus session's fixed release. Next step when it ships: bump the four pins and both locks to the fixed version and deploy; then Papyrus rebuilds papyrus-procedure-runner (expect only RunnerFunction Code), then the Cyclotron session executes the router change set (must keep ProcedureRunnerFunctionName via UsePreviousValue and RouterProcedureRunnerPolicy; adds dynamodb:UpdateItem and RouterAutomationReadPolicy); then verify: papyrus automations run --id distinctive.ttab dry run, one real run now on 92082396-CAN_53 (Overland Sheepskin v. Storyteller Overland, no story yet), and check runs, cost and TRIGGER#/ProcedureRun links.
